scripts.build: npm run build:rust && node scripts/gradle.mjs assembleRelease
scripts.check: tsc --noEmit && cargo fmt --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml -- --check && cargo clippy --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked --all-targets -- -D warnings
scripts.test: cargo test --manifest-path rust/Cargo.toml --locked && node scripts/jni-test.mjs && node scripts/gradle.mjs testDebugUnitTest
